However, if you take blood thinners, it also blocks your body's natural ability to make blood clot. So, if you take both of these medications together, it can increase your risk of bleeding. It's important to talk to your doctor or pharmacist about what is right for you. They may recommend lower doses of your blood thinner or suggest other medications that you can take instead.
